title: Keycloak: MariaDB Connector/J is used to connect applications developed in Java to MariaDB and MySQL databases…
description: A security vulnerability exists in the Keycloak package related to the MariaDB Connector/J used for Java applications connecting to MariaDB and MySQL databases. The vulnerability affects versions prior to 26.7.5-r3. It has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 5.9, indicating a network attack vector with high complexity and no privileges or user interaction required. The vulnerability impacts confidentiality but not integrity or availability. A patch is available in version 26.7.5-r3.
